kodi.title: Kodi
kodi.intro: KMM updates Kodi after changes to movies via the JSON-RPC interface. To allow this, enable “Allow remote control via HTTP” in Kodi under Settings → Services → Control and enter port, user and password here. With the path mapping KMM finds the movies under Kodi’s own paths, e.g. smb://nas/movies/.
